title: Exceptional combinations of tensile properties and corrosion resistance in a single-phase Ti1.6ZrNbMo0.35 refractory high-entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc-melting using high purity (>99.95 wt%) raw metals under an Ar atmosphere in a water-cooled copper crucible. The ingots were repeatedly remelted eight times to ensure chemical homogeneity and then dropped cast into a rectangular plate with the dimension of 60 × 25 × 12 mm³.
